name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 结论写多满，先看证据扛不扛得住
tagline_zh: 跑完分析最怕把「观察到」写成「导致」。它按证据强度分三级措辞：观察、方向、决策参考，没有实验设计就不许出现因果句。
tagline_en: Stops you from turning 'we observed' into 'it caused'. Three claim levels — observed, directional.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是润色，是给每句话标出它能承受的最大强度。效应量优先于戏剧性，措辞越界会被拦下来。
why_en: Not polishing — it caps each sentence at the strength its evidence supports. Effect sizes over drama; overreach gets flagged.
limit_zh: 只管措辞强度，不替你补证据：样本量不够、没有对照组，它只会把结论降级，不会让结论变对。也不做数据清洗和统计检验。
limit_en: Only governs wording strength — it won't fix weak evidence, just downgrade the claim. No data cleaning or stats; input must be finished results.
title_en: Write only what your evidence can carry
